title: What is a webhook? Explained for non-developers | 50agents
description: A webhook is a web address one app calls the moment something happens, sending the details, so another app can act straight away. Explained plainly.
definition: A webhook is a web address that one app calls the moment something happens, sending the details along, so another app can act on it straight away.
It is how apps push news to each other, instead of one app asking the other "anything new?" every few minutes.

example.ask: Set up an automation: every new Stripe payment is added as a row to my Google Sheet with the customer, amount and date
example.why: Stripe can call an address the moment a payment succeeds. Every 50agents automation has an address of its own, and Captain sets that start up when it builds it; you never paste one.
